actions.army.attack.fail: Cannot attack: requires adjacency, the army must not have acted, and the target must not be in a hostile battle
actions.army.attack.start: Attack launched: one round is resolved each turn until a winner emerges
actions.army.auto.failNotOwned: Cannot set automation: the target is not one of our armies
actions.army.autoGlobal.off: Global automation off: all armies are back under manual command
actions.army.autoGlobal.on: Global automation on: the panel is locked; turn off the gear to the right of the title to command manually
actions.army.disband.body: Disbanding will demobilize its {{count}} regiments; this cannot be undone.
actions.army.disband.fail: An army in combat cannot be disbanded
actions.army.disband.title: Disband {{name}}
actions.army.managedBlocked: This army is automated: cancel automation before issuing orders
actions.army.merge.fail: Cannot merge: armies must not have acted or be in combat, and the combined total must not exceed {{cap}} regiments
actions.army.merge.success: Merge ordered: smaller armies converge on the larger one
actions.army.redeploy.fail: This army has already acted this [[turn]], so it cannot be redeployed
actions.army.redeploy.start: Click a green province to complete the strategic transfer; press Esc to cancel
actions.army.select.needUnmanage: Cancel automation before selecting this army for a merge
actions.army.split.fail: Cannot split: the army must not have acted or be in combat, needs an empty neighboring province, and must not be at full strength
actions.army.split.success: Split complete: the new army moved into a neighboring empty province
actions.diplomacy.aid.fail: Cannot send an aid request: the cooldown is still active, no eligible non-overlord nation is available, or conditions have changed
actions.diplomacy.aid.success: Aid request sent; you will get an answer next turn
actions.diplomacy.alliance.create.body: Costs [[politics:{{cost}}]]. Once founded, you can invite nations that share an enemy or a similar strategic tendency; isolationists never found alliances.
actions.diplomacy.alliance.create.fail: Cannot create an alliance: insufficient [[politics]], already in one, or the current tendency is unsuitable
actions.diplomacy.alliance.create.succes: Alliance bloc created; you can invite members from the diplomacy panel
actions.diplomacy.alliance.create.title: Create an alliance bloc
actions.diplomacy.alliance.invite.fail: Cannot invite: only the alliance leader may send invitations, and both nations need a common enemy or a similar strategic tendency
actions.diplomacy.alliance.invite.succes: Alliance invitation sent; you will get an answer next turn
actions.diplomacy.alliance.join.fail: Cannot send a join request: you need a common enemy or a similar strategic tendency; after a rejection you cannot apply again for [[turn:{{days}}]]
actions.diplomacy.alliance.join.success: Join request sent; you will get an answer next turn
actions.diplomacy.alliance.leave.body: Leaving ends shared passage and common enemies at once; you cannot rejoin the same alliance for [[turn:{{days}}]].
actions.diplomacy.alliance.leave.fail: Cannot leave: we are not in any alliance
actions.diplomacy.claim.cancel.fail: Cannot cancel claim: we have no claim on that state, or we are at war with its owner
actions.diplomacy.claim.fail: Cannot claim: check [[politics]], adjacency and formal ownership, or the state may already be claimed
actions.diplomacy.claim.invalidState: Select a valid target state first
actions.diplomacy.claim.success: Claim on {{name}} filed; you still need a war goal
actions.diplomacy.cooldownFallback: Too many requests to this nation; try again later
actions.diplomacy.ended: The campaign is over; diplomatic actions are unavailable
actions.diplomacy.peace.accept.fail: Cannot accept white peace: the offer has expired or the war has ended
actions.diplomacy.peace.accept.success: Accepted {{nation}}'s white peace; both sides return temporary occupations and withdraw
actions.diplomacy.peace.reject.fail: Cannot reject: that white peace offer is no longer valid
actions.diplomacy.peace.white.notAccepte: {{nation}} did not accept white peace: the offer may have been rejected, or the two sides are no longer at war
actions.diplomacy.peace.white.success: White peace with {{nation}}; both sides return temporary occupations and withdraw
actions.diplomacy.prepare.cancel.fail: Cannot cancel: the diplomatic project is gone, already spent, or not ours
actions.diplomacy.prepare.cancel.success: Diplomatic project cancelled: the initial [[politics]] is refunded while still in progress; upkeep already spent is not returned
actions.diplomacy.prepare.fail: Cannot prepare: check [[politics]], claims, adjacency and truce terms; only one project per nation and no duplicates for the same target
actions.diplomacy.prepare.invalidKind: Invalid diplomatic preparation type; reopen the diplomacy page
actions.diplomacy.prepare.invalidState: Select an eligible target state first
actions.diplomacy.prepare.success: War goal preparation started: costs [[politics]] every turn; declare war once it is ready
actions.diplomacy.request.fail: Cannot respond: the request has expired or conditions are no longer met
actions.diplomacy.tribute.fail: Cannot adjust tribute: only cooperative vassals can be adjusted, within 5%–40%
actions.diplomacy.upgrade.fail: Cannot request a contract upgrade: independence must reach 60% of the cap, the nation's tendency must favor reform, [[politics]] must be sufficient, and the current contract must have room to improve
actions.diplomacy.upgrade.success: Contract upgrade request sent; you will get an answer next turn
actions.diplomacy.vassal.annex.fail: Cannot annex: only vassals with very low independence and no rebel intent can be annexed
actions.diplomacy.vassal.annex.success: {{nation}} annexed; its territory and armies are now ours
actions.diplomacy.vassal.demand.body: Settle as an oppressive vassal: no land is ceded; the target pays 30% of [[funds]]/[[industry]] and [[politics:3]] per turn, and cannot raise independence on its own. The demand is sent on confirmation and answered next turn; after a rejection you cannot demand again for [[turn:{{days}}]].
actions.diplomacy.vassal.demand.fail: Cannot send the vassal demand: the target must be clearly weaker than us or have no hope of continuing the war
actions.diplomacy.vassal.demand.success: Vassal demand sent; you will get an answer next turn
actions.diplomacy.vassal.demand.title: Demand that {{nation}} become a vassal
actions.diplomacy.vassal.enforce.body: Make peace on war-goal terms without ceding land: the target keeps its territory, pays 30% of [[funds]]/[[industry]] and [[politics:3]] per turn, and has very low independence it cannot raise on its own.
actions.diplomacy.vassal.enforce.fail: Cannot install as vassal: requires a total annexation war we started with its victory conditions met
actions.diplomacy.vassal.enforce.title: Make {{nation}} an oppressive vassal
actions.diplomacy.vassal.release.body: End the vassal relationship and grant a [[turn:10]] truce; tribute already collected is not refunded.
actions.diplomacy.vassal.release.fail: Cannot release: that nation is not your vassal
actions.diplomacy.vassal.release.title: Release {{nation}}
actions.diplomacy.vassal.request.fail: Cannot send the vassalization request: requires adjacency, neither side having an overlord, and the target seeing enough value in you
actions.diplomacy.vassal.request.success: Vassalization request sent; you will get an answer next turn
actions.diplomacy.vassal.type.body: Choose a new contract type; independence progress is kept proportionally and capped at the new limit.
actions.diplomacy.vassal.type.fail: Cannot change the contract: that nation is not your vassal, or already has that type
actions.diplomacy.vassal.type.title: Change {{nation}}'s vassal type
actions.diplomacy.war.declare.fail: Cannot declare war: the war goal is not ready, has expired or its target is invalid; a truce or an ongoing war may also block it
actions.diplomacy.war.declare.invalidGoa: Cannot declare war: finish a valid war goal first and use its declare-war button
actions.diplomacy.war.declare.success: War declared on {{nation}}; provinces will be contested per the agreed goal
actions.diplomacy.war.goal.fail: Cannot enforce the goal: requires a war we started and control of the target territory; annexation also checks the capital and third-party occupation
actions.diplomacy.war.goal.success: Peace with {{nation}} on war-goal terms; other temporary occupations are returned
actions.economy.build.cancel.success: Construction cancelled; half the resources were refunded
actions.economy.train.cancel.success: Training cancelled; half the resources were refunded
actions.economy.train.fail: Cannot recruit: not enough funds, industry, national or provincial army cap
